title: Butkara I Stupa
subtitle: Buddhist stupa and votive court on the eastern edge of Mingora, Swat
road: Sharif-Abad Makan-Bagh Road (OSM tertiary), then an unnamed unclassified street past the site
edits: A bench up to 24 m wide is cut along the jeep track to the smoothed track profile (the 30 m DSM includes tree canopy).
Road bumps and ruts in the drive are illustrative; the grade and the line of the track are real.
Trees, shrubs, grass tufts and boulders are placed where WorldCover maps that cover; their size and number are illustrative.
The walking loop is a 150 m circle around the arrival point; it is not a mapped trail.

The excavated sacred court is drawn from the Atlas photos (Front View of the main stupa, Votive Stupa Court): a rectangular flagged court about 60 x 50 m with a low edging wall. The court size is ESTIMATED from the photos. The court's depth below the surrounding ground is not measured and is NOT modelled: the court is drawn at ground level.

The main stupa is a rough stepped circular core about 19 m across, built of stacked courses with lighter bands (photos 01-03) and a broken top of rubble. No published dimensions were found (the Wikipedia article gives none): the diameter, the 6 m drum and the top are ESTIMATED from the photos.

The votive stupas are square stepped plinths 2 to 5 m across and 0.6 to 1.5 m high, in rows round the main stupa; most are ruined to the plinth and about one in six carries a small drum and dome. Their sizes, number and places are ESTIMATED from photos 01, 02 and 04 and invented to read as the court, not surveyed.
The whitewashed band on the lower front drum follows photo 03. Shades vary by about 8% between plinths. The paving slabs are a drawn texture, not surveyed.

The OSM building tagged as the site (tourism=museum, 36 m from the point) and every other building within 80 m are dropped and replaced by this model. The ground within 70 m is levelled (a terrace); the rest is the real DEM slope.
The earlier generic Atlas maquette (a ~22 m plinth with a ruined drum) is not used: it is not a record of this stupa.
The 2211 buildings stand on their OSM footprints; their height (OSM levels where mapped, else one or two storeys), roofs and colours are illustrative, after visitors' photos.
Season colours, snow, ice and dawn mist are illustrative.

Traffic on the drive is illustrative: the vehicle kinds are those seen on Swat roads (Willys jeeps, Hilux, Suzuki vans, Mehran cars, CD70 motorbikes, Qingqi rickshaws, painted trucks); their number and movement are not counted.
